snippet.title: Demra Rifts of War - Demo Trailer (Updated) - New Retro RTS
snippet.description:
New retro RTS/ RPG hybrid DEMO now available to play on steam.
Play a palading facing an demon invasion. Build your base, capture mines, conquer the map and train your army. Experience this new take on an retro RTS experience.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/4768380/Demra_Rifts_of_War_Demo/
